run_f_gold: run f_gold to count the number of set bits in an integer using Brian Kernighan algorithm
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled across multiple integer inputs to verify correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that counts set bits by repeatedly clearing the lowest set bit
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a different bit counting algorithm like bin or bit manipulation
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function and its test harness for edge cases and correctness
